column1: # The level 0 template table (bead tla-7xql.2, epic tla-7xql).
# A template is a named family of items with one generating idea. The grouping
# matters because bead tla-7xql.1, the stem-blind gate, runs PER TEMPLATE: the
# artifact it hunts is template-local, and a pooled number hides a bad template
# behind good ones. So the template is a column in swipe/level0/ITEMS.tsv and
# not a comment.
# Rows are tab-delimited and carry the literal marker TPL in field 1, so prose
# in this file can never be read as data. Read rows with awk -F'\t' or cut,
# never with IFS=$'\t' read: tab is IFS whitespace, so a run of tabs collapses
# and an empty field vanishes.
# A TPL ROW. Five fields, in order:
#   1  marker     the literal TPL
#   2  id         T1-T5, stable, never renumbered
#   3  name        three or four words
#   4  idea       the generating idea, one sentence
#   5  calibration the reading/ definitions the family was shaped against
#   awk -F'\t' '$1 == "TPL" && $2 == "T2"' swipe/level0/TEMPLATES.tsv
#   grep '^TPL' swipe/level0/TEMPLATES.tsv | cut -f2,3
# FIELD 5 IS PROVENANCE, NOT A DEPENDENCY. The 49 level 0 definitions already
# in reading/ are a starting point and the corpus is authored, so field 5 names
# what a family was shaped against rather than what it was extracted from. The
# bake never reads it.
TPL
